labels.name: documentation
labels.rationale: Names a specific docs error: the AI_POLICY.md link in CONTRIBUTING.md points at master, not main/current path.

body:
Thanks for the report. The link to `AI_POLICY.md` in `CONTRIBUTING.md` (https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) points at a file path on the `master` branch, so it can break. A maintainer will decide on the fix. The `documentation` label has been added for review.

Whether a pull request is accepted is also a maintainer decision. `CONTRIBUTING.md` asks contributors to describe the change in an issue first, and this issue does that. `AI_POLICY.md` covers AI-assisted contributions. Related: #4203 and #4029 discuss pull requests from outside contributors.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
